title: Trade Lite
description: A Simple and Light Weight Trade Plugin between Players
body:
# TradeLite Plugin for players

TradeLite is a plugin that allows users to trade items without worrying about losing items during the trading process; it’s completely safe.

## TradeLite Features
* **Quick and Easy Trading**: Anyone can send a trade request using Shift Right Click on any player.
* **No Item Loss**: In the event that a player logs out or the server crashes during a trade, all items traded will automatically revert back to the original owners.
* **No Lag Safety**: If the server is lagging when two players are trading items, the trading will stop until the lag resolves itself.
* **Easy to Configure**: Admins can limit the distance of trading between two players.

## TradeLite Commands
* **`/trade <player>`** – Requests an automated trade request with another player. (Shift-Right-Click to send)
* **`/trade accept`** – Accepts a trade request from another player. (Shift-Right-Click to accept)
* **`/trade deny`** – Denies a trade request from another player.
* **`/trade cancel`** – Cancels your trade.
* **`/trade reload`** – Reloads the configuration file (Admin Only).

### How to Install TradeLite
1. Upload the `TradeLite.jar` file to your server's `plugins` folder
2. Restart your server
3. Have fun!
